title: Memory in Claude Cowork, Editable Topics, and Sensitive Topics Setting
description: Memory now works across chat and Cowork in the cloud, with editable topics and a new sensitive topics setting that keeps items like health or beliefs out of memory unless enabled. Memory defaults to on for personal plans and off for organizations.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code has the memory of a goldfish
Claude Code Memory is here - feature has been out for a few weeks, is project-specific, doesn't span projects

title: Main branch updates - Claude 4.5/4.6, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek Reasoner
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models, expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash/Lite and 3 preview, added DeepSeek Reasoner model, and improved exception handling. Aider wrote 62% of the code in this release.

title: Codex CLI 0.149.1 with agent dashboard and improvements
description: New release adds interactive agents dashboard, working directory commands, queue for sessions, and expanded Vim editing. Includes bug fixes for queued messages, resumed sessions, and WebRTC connections.

title: Codex MCP server command deprecated
description: The `codex mcp-server` command is now deprecated. Users should use the Codex app server instead, or the Codex plugin for Claude Code.

title: New Copilot experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams
description: GitHub Copilot now brings shared agentic work to Slack and Microsoft Teams, allowing teams to collaborate with AI directly in their communication platforms. Teams can mention @GitHub to initiate AI collaboration, create issues, review code, and triage bugs.

community_feedback.quote: It's been so much fun working with the team on this. Try building with @github Copilot directly in Slack or Teams and give us feedback!
Another place to talk to AI - mixed reactions about necessity

title: Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements
description: Continued improvements to cloud agents and the Cursor harness system. Agents can now monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, and run scheduled tasks with subscriptions. Custom modes keep skills pinned in chat, and subagents run on isolated machines with the /goal command for long-lived objectives.

title: Origin Code Hosting Platform
description: Cursor launched Origin, a new code hosting platform and GitHub alternative. Features include repos, pull requests, issues, code review, and integrations with Vercel, Depot, and Buildkite. Designed for AI agents at scale with early beta on all paid plans.

community_feedback.quote: Origin - Cursor's code hosting platform is now live!
You can now code with Grok via Cursor and host your code on Origin, all in one place
Trust concerns about hosting proprietary code with the service

title: Cloud Agents Start 3x Faster with Builds
description: New Builds system provides pre-configured environments that agents boot into, delivering 10x faster environment boot and 3x faster time to first token. Agents use last successful build if environment breaks, with build history dashboard for inspection.

title: Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash available in Copilot
description: New AI models Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash are now available in GitHub Copilot, providing developers with more model choices for AI-assisted coding.

community_feedback.quote: It's a great model, It is definitely smarter, but it seems to use more tokens and turns complete slower. This makes it somewhat awkward to use.
Gemini-3.7-flash is surprisingly pleasant to use. I prefer it. It's fast and much better at UI.
my favorite model is still grok-4.6. Best...

title: Weekly releases - August 3, 2026
description: Updates across GitHub Copilot desktop app, CLI, and VS Code. Desktop Auto feature now displays model handling and AI credit info. CLI adds Sessions sidebar for managing concurrent sessions and experimental /worktree command. VS Code 1.132 adds element-level browser feedback and /btw command for side chats.

title: Security Scanning for Enterprise Skills and Plugins
description: Enterprise plans received beta access to skill and plugin security scanning, which automatically checks third-party skills and plugins for malicious content when members upload or modify them.

title: Google Workspace Plugins Integration
description: New integration with Google Workspace including Gmail for email management, Google Drive for file access and organization, and Google Calendar for scheduling capabilities.
